case_title: ALEXANDER PERLOV VS. MARCOS ALBERTO BARD CAMEY

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-31-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-31-2023 BY JUDGE MURLENE J. RANDLE. PLAINTIFF ALEXANDER PERLOV IS PRESENT.
